# In-repository expression conformance corpus

The original corpus was imported from the Yawr design work. GXL evaluation
cases 093–105 were consolidated from `yawr-private` commit
`1990a6c7749dc6ee109d1e197815d6f2ed83d122`.

The files here are canonical in-repository test inputs. Do not synchronize
them from an external checkout. Stable case IDs are merged only when existing
definitions are byte-for-byte equivalent; collisions with different content
must fail corpus validation.
